description: Apply a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) to the data document. Each operation is `{ op, path, value? }`. Omit both `path` and `segments` to patch the root of the data hierarchy, which is how a whole new top-level document is added.

path.description: Data path the patch is applied to.

segments.description: Path as literal key segments, e.g. ["labels", "app.kubernetes.io/name"]. Use instead of `path` when a key contains a dot or a slash.

name: opa_patch_data
title: Patch data on OPA
